inspected_originals.name: parameter.py
inspected_originals.inspection_note: A kind of Tensor that is to be considered a module parameter. Parameters are Tensor subclasses registered as module parameters; requires_grad defaults to True.

inspected_originals.name: linear.py
inspected_originals.inspection_note: Applies an affine linear transformation to the incoming data: y = xA^T + b. Attributes weight and bias are learnable.

inspected_originals.name: sparse.py
inspected_originals.inspection_note: A simple lookup table that stores embeddings of a fixed dictionary and size. The input is a list of indices; the output is the corresponding word embeddings.

inspected_originals.name: quickstart_tutorial.py
inspected_originals.locator: Optimizing the Model Parameters: train and test; Saving Models
inspected_originals.inspection_note: The model makes predictions on the training dataset and backpropagates the prediction error to adjust parameters. The separate test function uses model.eval() and torch.no_grad(). The state dictionary contains model parameters.

inspected_originals.inspection_note: Colab is a hosted Jupyter Notebook service. Notebooks can be loaded from GitHub. Code is executed in a virtual machine private to your account.
